label: Some existing individual at some root-accessible world attains a…, by Existential-introduction
meaning: Structural witness selection from the named-individual conclusion, not a second philosophical derivation. Actual reflexivity selects the standpoint as an accessible world, and the named conclusion supplies n's presence there and its bound on every existing accessible-world pair. This constructs a witness of possible global attainment. Possible attainment is strictly weaker in the tested controls than n attaining a global bound at every accessible world; it is not a value bridge or a formalization of source steps1–5 as a whole. No independent premise defense or root-premise change is claimed.
